name: ailang-tools
description: Repo-local Claude Code plugins for AILANG development

plugins.name: ailang-go-lsp
plugins.description: gopls language server for the AILANG Go implementation — instant diagnostics, go-to-def, find references, hover types. Requires gopls on PATH.

plugins.name: ailang-lsp
plugins.description: AILANG language server (`ailang lsp --stdio`) for .ail files — diagnostics on save, hover types, go-to-definition, references, document symbols. Requires the `ailang` binary on PATH.
